statements.subject: connection
statements.description: The connection MUST be reset if: o  the Change option's feature number was not understood; o  the Change option's value was invalid, and the receiver would normally have sent an empty Confirm option in response; or o  for server-priority features, there was no shared entry in the two endpoints' preference lists.
statements.pre_cond: mandatory_change_option.received = true & (mandatory_change_option.feature_number_understood = false | (mandatory_change_option.value_invalid = true & receiver.would_send_empty_confirm = true) | (feature.server_priority = true & preference_lists.shared_entry = false))
actions: Send Reset with Reset Code 6 'Mandatory Failure'
